title: COCOA.jl: A Julia package for high-performance analysis of concordance and kinetic modules in biochemical networks
description: COCOA.jl is a Julia package for concordance and kinetic-module analysis of genome-scale biochemical reaction networks. It reimplements and scales the Upstream Algorithm of Küken et al. (2022) and Langary et al. (2025), adding cached parallel LP solves, transitivity-based pruning, and streaming candidate filtering, and integrates with COBREXA.jl / AbstractFBCModels. v1.1.0 accompanies the Bioinformatics application note (BIOINF-2026-1436); v1.2.0 adds correctness fixes for genome-scale analyses (see CHANGELOG.md).
